title: Executor: classify quota_exhausted and runner_error from runner evidence at collect
description:
Follow-up from qg5 (DONE_WITH_CONCERNS). contracts/job-protocol.json defines a quota_exhausted failure class so a flat-rate seat running out of quota is not reported as a broken route; today a codex run that hits its usage limit collects as no-commits / runner_error. Add a failure-class hint derived from the runner's exit and its log tail (diagnostic material only — never a completion signal): codex 'You have hit your usage limit' / claude and pi equivalents -> quota_exhausted; unknown flag or usage error (exit 2) -> a distinct configuration class per the contract vocabulary; otherwise runner_error. Golden a codex usage-limit log captured on 2026-09-02 as a fixture. Scope: internal/exec/subprocess only (collect.go, report/vocabulary tests). Do not touch internal/reconcile (built concurrently by px2) or any other package. Read RESULT of qg5 in git history and lifecycle_test.go before starting.

## Also in scope (CI flake found after qg5 closed)
CI run https://github.com/pengelbrecht/ticfac/actions/runs/33676508385 failed on linux with: TestA1StopRefusesToIssueAndRevocationPrecedesTeardown/stop_refuses_issue — 'testing.go: TempDir RemoveAll cleanup: unlinkat .../state/<repo>/<attempt>: directory not empty'. Cause: the guard-off fixture in lifecycle_test.go Starts a job (a supervisor that outlives the call) and the subtest returns without cancelling or reaping it, so the supervisor writes into the state dir while t.TempDir is being removed. Fix in the fixture (harness_test.go / lifecycle_test.go): register a t.Cleanup that cancels every started attempt and waits for its supervisor to exit before TempDir cleanup runs; audit every test that Starts without collecting/cancelling. Verify with go test -short -count=5 ./internal/exec/subprocess. Same package as the rest of this tick; you are the only worker touching internal/exec/subprocess this wave.

## How this fits
Wave 3 of epic qeu, running in parallel with px2 (the reconciler, internal/reconcile + cmd/ticfac). Integration commit d609c8e73548e7530d980d1e9b716e051cc4722d on epic/qeu contains the executor (qg5), run-state store (xkd) and tk client (y7o). Stay inside internal/exec/subprocess; do not touch go.mod, README.md, contracts/ or any other package. Verify your base: git merge-base --is-ancestor d609c8e73548e7530d980d1e9b716e051cc4722d HEAD.
